title: Ad-hoc interlock owners parachute plan
content:
Purpose: lightweight, one-page spreadsheet for cross-team owners to coordinate immediate fallbacks ("parachute") when a primary route/model degrades. Not a full runbook — quick contacts, estimated failover times, and scoped asks so triage can hand off in 10–20 minutes.

Columns: Owner | Team | Contact (slack/email) | Primary route / model | Typical high-risk window (UTC) | Suggested fallback | Fallback owner | Est. failover time (mins) | SLA impact (p0/p1/p2) | Current mitigation | Quick asks (<=3) | Last tested | Notes

Rows:
Samira Khan | eng-serving-runtime | @samira / samira@redwood.ai | hosted-api/text-gen (v3.1) | 14:00-18:00 | hosted-api/text-gen-quantized | Ryan Li | 7 | p0 | KV prefix caching + pre-warm | 1) Verify pre-warm script runs on deploy 2) Short circuit heavy batching if latency > 300ms | 2029-03-12 | need rollback snippet in repo
Ryan Li | infrastructure | @ryan / ryan@redwood.ai | dedicated/pool-eu-1 (burst) | 09:00-11:30 | dedicated/pool-eu-2 (cold) | Ayesha Patel | 12 | p0 | autoscale + reserve buffer | 1) Coordinate capacity share with SE team 2) Enable limited burst override | 2029-02-28 | capacity reclaim script untested during peak
Ayesha Patel | product-hosted-api | @ayesha / ayesha@redwood.ai | embeddings-route (bulk) | 00:00-06:00 | embeddings-lite (reduced dims) | Priya Narang | 15 | p1 | rate-limit per-tenant | 1) Prep customer comms snippet 2) Toggle reduced-dim model via feature flag | 2029-01-20 | prod flag: feature/embeds-dim-switch
Diego Morales | eng-sre | @diego / diego@redwood.ai | regional-fallback-router | 17:00-20:00 | global-fallback-router | Samira Khan | 5 | p0 | route health checks + tracer | 1) Validate weight rebalancer 2) Re-run smoke tests for global router | 2029-03-05 | tracer sampling 0.1 causes gaps
Priya Narang | solutions-engineering | @priya / priya@redwood.ai | se-onboarding-demo | 12:00-14:00 | se-onboarding-demo-local | Diego Morales | 10 | p2 | local docker images cached | 1) Keep demo image in warm cache 2) Provide contact for demo failover | 2029-03-01 | demos scheduled by SE ops
Emma Walker | customer-success | @emma / emma@redwood.ai | customer-sandbox | 08:00-16:00 | sandbox-limited | Ayesha Patel | 20 | p1 | token quotas + sandbox throttle | 1) Send temp sandbox instructions to customers 2) Short-term quota bump process | 2029-02-14 | manual step in billing UI
Caleb Novak | release-engineering | @caleb / caleb@redwood.ai | rollout/canary-route | 10:00-13:00 | rollback-to-stable | Ryan Li | 3 | p0 | canary monitor alerts | 1) Keep last-stable image tag pinned 2) quick rollback playbook in PR template | 2029-03-11 | runbook link in PR checklist

Action items (short horizon):
1) Samira: Add exact CLI commands for fallback toggle to this sheet (due 2029-03-20)
2) Ryan: Run a simulated failover drill for dedicated pools (due 2029-03-25)
3) Ayesha: Draft a 1-paragraph template for customer comms for embedding quality regressions (due 2029-03-22)
4) Diego: Add a simple health-check dashboard link next to each row (due 2029-03-21)
5) Priya: Confirm SE demo local images are available in EU registry (done/unblocked by 2029-03-19)

Quick notes / constraints: this sheet is intentionally terse. If an incident escalates, move to the incident runbook and tag the incident number in the "Notes" column. Use the slack channel #incident-parachute for immediate handoffs. When a fallback is exercised, update "Last tested" to today and create a one-paragraph postmortem in Confluence.

Version history (brief):
- 2029-03-15 created (initial owner map)
- 2029-03-18 minor edits (added Caleb / release-engineering row, action item 2)
